$comment: Advisories that npm audit reports but that are knowingly deferred or accepted. CI (scripts/security/auditCheck.ts) fails only on NEW high/critical advisories not listed here. Every group must be re-reviewed by its reviewBy date. See docs/SECURITY_DEPENDENCIES.md.

groups.name: framework-security-migration
groups.reason: No patched Next.js 14.x release exists (14.2.35 is the final 14.x). Every fix is on Next 15.5.x/16.x, which requires React 19 for the App Router and therefore also R3F 9 / Drei 10. Requires a dedicated migration sprint (Server Actions, middleware, Supabase cookie/auth, payment flow, 3D stack). Not part of the dependency-patch sprint.
groups.exposure: PRODUCTION. Realistic exposure is denial-of-service / information-disclosure class on the App Router + Server Actions. Advisories for Windows-hosted RCE, next/image optimizer, WebSocket upgrades, rewrites, Pages Router i18n, CSP nonces and next/script do not apply to this app configuration (App Router only; no rewrites, i18n, next/image use, custom server). Assumes Vercel hosting (not verified in this sprint).

groups.name: xlsx-trusted-local-tooling
groups.reason: npm has no fixed xlsx release (0.18.5 is the last on the registry; fixes ship only from cdn.sheetjs.com). Deliberately not replaced with an unverified tarball in this sprint.
groups.exposure: DEV-ONLY. xlsx is a devDependency, used only by local question-bank CLI tooling reading a trusted, team-authored workbook. It is tree-shaken out of the production build; no upload or untrusted spreadsheet path exists.

groups.name: vitest-mocker-dev-only
groups.reason: Fix requires vitest >= 4.1.11. npm 10.9.3 cannot resolve it (Arborist crash), and newer npm resolves it only via Vite 8 (Rolldown), a bundler migration. Deferred; vitest 3.2.7 already clears the critical Vitest UI, vite and esbuild advisories.
groups.exposure: DEV-ONLY. Test tooling only; needs a redirect mock with attacker-controlled input. Vitest UI is not installed and the test command never starts a listening server.
